notes: 'their tents' is marked added for the possessive because אֹהָלִים is absolute with no suffix; the competing reading would fold it into the tents unit, which rule 18's closing sentence forbids.
The 'in' of 'in his place' is locative rather than a word spent on the object relation, so it stays with יָד and the object marker is unrepresented (rules 16, 33).
